subject: Hand-off: Exec briefing + demo — locking VP/CIO attendance for OdinWorks
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@odinworks.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Bryan Cole <bryan.cole@odinworks.com>
Date: 2027-08-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro: Redwood demo — exec briefing request

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the quick intro on the call yesterday. OdinWorks is preparing a short vendor briefing for our leadership team ahead of the Q4 vendor shortlist, and we'd like Redwood to present a focused 30–40 minute session that includes: an executive overview, a short live demo of latency-sensitive features, and a Q&A for VP/CIO stakeholders.

Can you confirm whether a VP-level product or engineering sponsor + the CIO could join? Our leadership availability window is next week: Tue (8/24) 10:00–11:30am PT or Wed (8/25) 2:00–4:00pm PT. If those don't work we can push to the following week but prefer to lock this week.

Quick notes:
- Audience: CIO (Bryan Cole), VP Product (Alicia Gomez), Head of SRE (Tara Lin - will join if CIO unavailable)
- Preliminary agenda attached (ODIN QBR deck.pdf)
- We need any SSO/SCIM checklist up front if possible

Thanks — Alicia

--
Alicia Gomez
VP Product Strategy | OdinWorks
Alicia.gomez@odinworks.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0132
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@odinworks.com>
Cc: Bryan Cole <bryan.cole@odinworks.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-22T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood demo — exec briefing request

Alicia — thanks, love the agenda shape. We can absolutely run a condensed exec briefing + targeted demo for your CIO/VP. Quick confirmation and a couple of asks so we can lock resources: 

1) Proposed slots (we can cover those windows) — please pick one:
   - Tue 8/24, 10:30–11:10am PT (30–40m)
   - Wed 8/25, 2:30–3:10pm PT (30–40m)

2) Who should we prep for the demo? CIO-level priorities (latency, cost, multiregion failover) vs product priorities (model quality & rollout). We can emphasize both but want to know the primary ask.

3) SSO/KBA: if you can share your IdP (Okta/Azure AD) vendor and whether you need a SOC2 summary, we’ll attach the checklist.

Internally, I'll loop in Marissa to secure a VP-level product sponsor and Karthik to prepare a short infra slide about latency SLAs and fallback routing. If the CIO cannot make, please confirm if Tara Lin (Head of SRE) is OK as a backup.

Attachment: ODIN-internal-assignments.xlsx (internal workplan for this thread)

I'll hold Tue 10:30 on my calendar tentatively until you confirm.

Best,
Priyom
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priom_das@redwood.com
Office: 415-555-0199
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: (none)
Date: 2027-08-22T10:07:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Intro: Redwood demo — exec briefing request — quick internal note

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding the OdinWorks request. Quick asks: 

- Marissa: can you check your VP product contacts and confirm who can join Tue 10:30–11:10am PT? Ideally someone who can speak to roadmap & pricing guardrails. If VP unavailable, a Head of Product will do but I'd prefer a name to include in the invite.
- Karthik: can you prepare a 6-slide appendix focused on latency SLOs, multiregion routing, and our fallback model variant story (10–12 min total across infra + demo). Keep it high level for CIO.

Plan: hold Tue 10:30 locally for 30–40 minutes. If Alicia confirms Wed instead we’ll pivot.

Thanks — this is a high-prop deal and CIO attendance increases likelihood of an RFP.

Priyom
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@odinworks.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Bryan Cole <bryan.cole@odinworks.com>
Date: 2027-08-22T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood demo — exec briefing request

Priyom — thanks for the fast turnaround. We’ll take Tue 8/24 10:30–11:10am PT. Bryan (CIO) confirmed he can join the start of the slot and stay ~20 minutes; Tara Lin will be available as backup for the last 10 minutes if needed.

Agenda: 10:30–10:40 Exec overview + fit for OdinWorks (Alicia/Bryan)
10:40–10:55 Redwood demo (Priyom + Karthik)
10:55–11:10 Q&A + next steps (procurement handoff)

SSO: we use Okta — I’ll share our metadata tomorrow. We also need a short procurement contact for NDAs/PO routing: procurement@odinworks.com (CC’ed Bryan).

Confirming attachments: we reviewed the deck and the internal assignments — thanks. DocuSign: please send NDAs to procurement@odinworks.com; we’ll aim to get those back within 48 hours.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=odinjfexample123

See you Tuesday — Alicia
